test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:
(1) The chef tasted the soup.
(2) He added a pinch of salt.
(3) He stirred it slowly.
(4) He smiled, satisfied.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sequence of actions follows a logical flow, starting with the chef tasting the soup, adding a pinch of salt, stirring it slowly, and finally smiling with satisfaction.
 
• **Sentence 1** is the first because it sets the stag
